name: Spider-Man 2099
oracle_text:
From the Future — You can't cast Spider-Man 2099 during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
Double strike, vigilance
At the beginning of your end step, if you've played a land or cast a spell this turn from anywhere other than your hand, Spider-Man 2099 deals damage equal to his power to any target.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you've played a land or cast a spell this turn from anywhere other than your hand, Spider-Man 2099 deals damage equal to his power to any target.

needs.what: a turn-ledger value (or condition) counting the lands a player played and the spells a player cast this turn from a zone other than their hand (graveyard, exile, library top, command zone), e.g. {"plays_this_turn": {"player": "you", "except_zones": ["hand"], "lands": true, "spells": true}}, readable as an end_step trigger's intervening-if condition
needs.why_existing_wont_do: spells_cast_this_turn takes a filter, but it is matched by _matches_printed against the spell's printed face and the ledger (spells_cast_ids) records no origin zone, so it cannot tell a hand cast from a graveyard/exile/command-zone cast; no value_key records land plays at all, let alone their origin zone; cast_from_hand / cast_from_graveyard conditions only describe the card's own cast, and has_turn_flag would need an unprinted trigger to set the flag
